purpose: This table is the cleaned, deduplication-checked record of every OurAirports airport carrying an IATA code, feeding downstream airport reference and geolocation lookups.
usage: Consumers should join on id as the primary key, filter is_scheduled_service to distinguish airports with scheduled commercial service, and treat NA in continent_code and iso_country_code as the valid codes for North America and Namibia rather than missing data; nullable code and link columns (icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, keywords, municipality) require explicit null handling before use.
limitations: Highly sparse columns (local_code at 63.6635% null, home_link at 74.9034% null, keywords at 67.9585% null) were retained as-is without imputation and may limit coverage for use cases depending on them; elevation_feet retains 3.6988% nulls where no elevation was recorded, and the table carried a measured duplicate_row_rate of 0.0 at profiling time so no dedupe logic was applied.
